## 2026-05-09 - XXE Vulnerability in JUnit XML Parsing
**Vulnerability:** XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in test parser using standard `xml.etree.ElementTree`.
**Learning:** `xml.etree.ElementTree` is inherently vulnerable to XXE attacks when parsing untrusted XML, which can lead to local file disclosure or SSRF.
**Prevention:** Always use `defusedxml.ElementTree` instead of `xml.etree.ElementTree` when parsing XML files, especially those generated by external tools.
